instructions: Think about the last 2 weeks. For each item, choose how often it has bothered you. There are no right or wrong answers.
prompt: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by:

traits.name: Worry & overthinking
traits.description: How often your mind gets caught in worrying or going over things.

traits.name: Nervousness
traits.description: How often you feel on edge or uneasy.

traits.name: Physical tension
traits.description: How often stress shows up in your body.

traits.name: Difficulty relaxing
traits.description: How easy it is to switch off and settle.

traits.name: Fear & apprehension
traits.description: How often you expect or fear that something bad will happen.

traits.name: Stress response
traits.description: How stress affects your mood, focus and reactions.

questions.text: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Trouble relaxing
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Becoming easily annoyed or irritable
Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen
Replaying conversations or events in your mind long after they happened
Thinking through everything that could go wrong before you do something
Second-guessing yourself so much that decisions feel hard
Feeling uneasy in situations that most people seem to find ordinary
Getting a nervous stomach before everyday tasks
Needing reassurance from others before you can feel calm
Noticing tight muscles in your neck, shoulders or jaw
A racing heart or shallow breathing when you feel stressed
Headaches or stomach aches when you are under pressure
Lying awake because your mind will not switch off
Finding it hard to enjoy free time because you feel you should be doing something
Feeling unable to settle even when nothing urgent needs doing
Avoiding places or situations because of how anxious they might make you feel
Expecting bad news when your phone rings or a message arrives
A sense of dread about the days ahead
Feeling overwhelmed by tasks you would normally manage
Snapping at people when you are under stress
Struggling to concentrate because worries keep interrupting you
